description: A close portrait of a monstrous woman whose hair is a mass of writhing green snakes, framed to the shoulders, facing the viewer. Her face is pale cyan-white with harsh blue and violet shading, her eyes narrow and red-rimmed, her open mouth showing sharp fangs. The snakes are vivid green with dark outlines, coiling down both sides, their small heads lifting at the crown. A dark blue and violet robe drapes her shoulders. The background is flat dark grey. The light is cold; the mood venomous and hypnotic. Frame 1: the mouth is half open. Frame 2: the mouth opens a little more. Frame 3: the jaw drops wider and the snakes at the crown shift. Frame 4: the mouth is at its widest in a hiss, held longest. Frame 5: a snake head at the top twitches, a flash. Frame 6: another snake twitches, a flash. Frame 7: the mouth starts to close. Frame 8: the mouth returns to half open. The loop reads as a steady hissing breath, snakes squirming.
title: Medusa hissing with snake hair
